files.core/activeProjects.md:
# Active Projects

- Atlas — React application; Boreal — Python API; pi-memory3 — persistent memory extension.
files.knowledge/memory-injection.md:
# pi-memory3 injection limits (pi-memory3, withholding, truncation, injection, prompt budget)

Three knowledge/history files may enter a prompt. Core context is direct. Oversized records are named instead of sent when more than half would be hidden. Read a withheld record before editing it.
files.knowledge/memory-concurrency.md:
# pi-memory3 concurrent bank writes (concurrent, stale-base, serialization, fingerprint, append)

Cooperating memory tools serialize updates and appends. Compare content fingerprints, not modification dates. A stale replacement must reread the current record.
files.knowledge/atlas-forms.md:
# Atlas React forms (react, forms, double-submit, debounce, onClick)

Disable the Save button during an outstanding request. Controlled input owns the displayed value. A second submit must not create a second payment.
files.knowledge/atlas-style.md:
# Atlas Tailwind styling (tailwind, spacing, modal, dark-mode)

Use spacing scale values. Put dark mode classes on the application root. Modal colors inherit the active theme.
files.knowledge/boreal-postgres.md:
# Boreal Postgres migrations (postgres, migrations, concurrent-index, downtime)

Add nullable columns first. Build indexes concurrently. Avoid ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks on hot tables. Configure lock timeout.
files.knowledge/boreal-python.md:
# Boreal Python profiling (python, profiling, comprehension, performance)

Profile the loop before rewriting it. Calling expensive functions inside a comprehension is still expensive. Benchmark with realistic rows.
files.knowledge/lumo-build.md:
# LUMO macOS build (lumo, macos, cmake, wxwidgets)

Use the pinned wxWidgets toolchain and build LUMO with CMake. Match the architecture of dependent libraries.
files.knowledge/lumo-import.md:
# LUMO Pineledger import (lumo, pineledger, importer, reconciliation)

Dry-run first. Apply to a backup copy, verify balances and rerun for idempotency. Never write a database while the GUI holds it open.
files.knowledge/harbor-stack.md:
# Harbor estimator prototype (harbor, estimator, prototype, svelte)

The prototype uses Svelte and TypeScript. Product and UX specifications remain authoritative, not the prototype's accidental behavior.
files.knowledge/background-blue.md:
# Atlas background policy (background, color, atlas, blue, palette, theme)

2026-11-01 decision: the Atlas application background is blue. This is an older decision, retained here as an evaluation rival.
files.knowledge/background-green.md:
# Atlas background amendment (background, color, green)

2026-11-02 decision supersedes blue: the Atlas background is green. Prefer this newer decision when records disagree.
